name: osint
description: Identity OSINT (sherlock, maigret, holehe, h8mail, whatsmyname, social_analyzer, ghunt, recon_ng, spiderfoot). Same isolation as recon — RO root, ephemeral /work — but network egress is conceptually restricted to the operator's identity-target domains. v2.3 leaves wire filtering to the host firewall; v2.4 will introduce per-tool domain allowlists.
